description: Machine index of dynamic-workflow golden test cases for the codex-graph skill. Derived from real Grok Rhai workflows and Claude multi-agent orchestration shapes; goals are synthetic and anonymized. See docs/dynamic-workflow-testcase-catalog.md for provenance.

cases.title: Atomic per-candidate screening fan-out with root-owned pool policy
cases.source_shape: Grok destination/hotel discovery screen phase: one candidate in, one verdict out; fail-open policy decided by the orchestrator
cases.fanout: one read-only screener per candidate (representative width 3, real runs 24-100+)
cases.join: root applies verdicts and fail-open policy deterministically; workers never decide pool membership
cases.validation: hard gates only inside screeners; kill log preserved

cases.title: Disjoint-slice generators joined by one integration owner
cases.source_shape: Grok atomic generators: one generator per region/archetype slice, orchestrator dedupes into one pool
cases.fanout: one generator per declared disjoint slice
cases.join: one integration owner; deterministic exact-name dedupe in orchestration code, not in worker prompts
cases.validation: schema-shaped generator handoffs; malformed handoffs dropped with a logged reason

cases.title: Sealed decision packs with adversarial per-pack fact-check
cases.source_shape: Grok sealed POV workers (no cross-candidate knowledge) each followed by one adversarial refuting fact-checker
cases.fanout: one sealed researcher per item, then one fact-checker per pack
cases.join: root gate; a missing or failed fact-check marks claims UNVERIFIABLE, never confirmed
cases.validation: adversarial evidence lanes fail closed; full packs preserved in a durable artifact with compact handoffs

cases.title: Non-binding synthesis with root-owned acceptance (human ranks)
cases.source_shape: Grok light synthesis: matrix plus provisional thoughts, winners forbidden; inverse of the Lisbon synthesis self-block defect
cases.fanout: topic collectors, then read-only audit lenses after synthesis
cases.join: root gate owns acceptance; synthesizer returns a draft and must not wait for downstream audits
cases.validation: audit lenses check schema and coverage only; synthesis never declares a winner or blocks itself

cases.title: Blind dual validators with fail-closed verdicts and one root gate
cases.source_shape: Grok blind judge panels with distinct priorities and Claude review-scorer panels; one binding aggregate owner
cases.fanout: independent validators with disjoint criteria over the same artifact
cases.join: index-aligned regroup; one root gate aggregates; no validator approves alone
cases.validation: malformed or missing verdicts fail closed; exactly one repair allowance

cases.title: Per-node environments: local discovery, disjoint worktree writers
cases.source_shape: Claude disjoint implement teammates in isolated worktrees with a director that owns integration and publication
cases.fanout: two writers with demonstrably disjoint file scopes; discovery stays read-only
cases.join: root integration owner publishes the final artifact from the real checkout, not from a disposable worktree
cases.validation: targeted checks after integration; pending worktree setup resolved with provisioning-scale bounds
